Title: Hard Salt Beef
Writer: Aziza Barnes, Ira Parker, George R.R. Martin
Actors: Peter Claffey, Dexter Sol Ansell, Bertie Carvel
Plot: Dunk appeals to various lords in order to gain entrance into the tournament, but Egg advises him to hold onto his pride. When the Targaryens arrive at Ashford, Dunk seizes his moment with Prince Baelor.
